WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT o.weathprofile, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusage, COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM telescopes AS t
  JOIN observatories AS o
    ON o.observstation = t.observstation
  WHERE t.detecttempk >= 152.1
  GROUP BY o.weathprofile
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_bandusage) AS overall_avg
  FROM step1
)
SELECT step1.weathprofile, step1.avg_bandusage, step1.record_count,
       step1.avg_bandusage - step2.overall_avg
FROM step1
JOIN step2 ON step2.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
